Meta.title: Hirun Chatcharoensawat | AI Engineer & Full Stack Developer
Meta.description: Portfolio of Hirun Chatcharoensawat — AI Engineer and Full Stack Developer working with LLMs, web applications and machine learning.

Hero.name: Hirun Chatcharoensawat
Hero.description: I'm passionate about AI and always learning, with a focus on applying the latest advances to real-world projects — currently Large Language Models (LLMs).

About.title: About Me
About.description: I'm an AI Engineer and Full Stack Developer with a strong interest in Artificial Intelligence, especially Large Language Models (LLMs). I combine this with modern web development to build practical, reliable products.

exp1.desc: Tested the Alphalink system, improved the performance of the thai-link website, designed UX/UI in Figma, and developed an online auction platform.

exp2.desc: Worked on full-stack development, prompt engineering and database design, using AI CLI and MCP tools.

exp3.desc: Developed financial and tax calculation websites.

exp4.company: Strategy and Planning Office, Suan Dusit University
exp4.desc: Developed university assessment systems and analyzed evaluation data.

proj1.title: Smart Recipe Recommender
proj1.desc: Recommends recipes based on the ingredients you have, using content-based filtering. Built a Thai recipe dataset and a database to store user preferences.

proj2.title: Trading Tax & Cash Flow Calculator
proj2.desc: Automatically calculates taxes and deductions on buy and sell transactions, tracks daily trades, and monitors cash inflow and outflow.

proj3.title: News Website Optimization
proj3.desc: Improved UX and navigation on a news website and upgraded its architecture to support modern web technologies.

proj4.title: Sales Data Analysis
proj4.desc: Analyzed sales data for promotional campaigns and export strategies using Kaggle datasets, and compared machine learning models, including decision trees, to evaluate effectiveness.

vns.title: V.N.S. Engineering Hydraulic
vns.desc: Bilingual company website for a manufacturer of hydraulic hose fittings and industrial connectors, with product catalog, company profile and contact pages.

botMigration.title: Website Content Migration
botMigration.desc: Migrated website content from the legacy system to the new platform, including images, magazines/publications and text content, and checked that everything was complete and displayed correctly.

anandaBidding.title: E-Bidding System — ANANDA
anandaBidding.desc: Online procurement bidding platform for sourcing projects, bidding events and supplier bids. My contributions: the event lifecycle (publish, edit, extend/shorten deadlines, close and reopen), supplier management (Excel import with validation, profiles, search), and the approval workflow with email notifications and Excel export. Also gathered feedback directly from the client and implemented the requested changes and fixes.

tmmlWorkforce.title: Foreign Worker Management System — TMML
tmmlWorkforce.desc: Back-office system for a labor recruitment company, covering employer and worker records, financial documents and contracts. Tested system functionality, reported bugs to the development team, and wrote the user documentation.

pimmz.title: PIMMZ
pimmz.desc: Procurement club and business networking platform where members post buy/sell listings, services and training seminars, and connect with other businesses.

myStocks.title: My Stocks
myStocks.desc: Stock tracking and screening web app for US and Thai (SET) markets, built for DCA, dividend and growth investing. Features technical charts (SMA, RSI), a custom condition screener, a THB-based portfolio tracker, DCA backtesting, and LINE / Telegram alerts with a LINE chatbot for portfolio queries.

clearBill.title: ClearBill
clearBill.desc: Expense reimbursement app that removes manual data entry. Snap a receipt or transfer slip and AI (Gemini Vision + OCR) extracts the amount, category and payer. Records are saved to Google Sheets with images in Google Drive. Includes an expense dashboard, printable reports with Excel export, and a monthly LINE summary sent to everyone with claims.

ninjaCodeBug.title: NinjaCodeBug
ninjaCodeBug.desc: Portfolio hub and web development service site that showcases projects by category, with search, gallery-style detail pages, view counts and light/dark mode, plus an admin dashboard for managing projects and uploading images.
